# GiveMeSub

> A macOS menu bar app that captions whatever your Mac plays. It taps system audio, transcribes it on-device with a bundled speech model, and shows the words in a floating overlay above every window, fullscreen apps included. No servers, accounts or tracking. Open source under MIT.

## Pages

- [Home](https://give-me-sub.kirhgoff.me/): what it does, how it works, install with Homebrew
